market_specific_notes: Miami dental shoppers usually need a tighter way to compare urgency, specialist fit, and total scope instead of generic office marketing.
The strongest local comparison in Miami is usually who can explain scope, timing, and quote boundaries clearly.
local_vetting_points: Ask whether imaging, temporaries, follow-up, and specialist referral are included in the quote.
Ask whether urgent work is being separated from optional or cosmetic work.
Ask which clinician actually performs the procedure if several providers are involved.
Curated local pages should help readers compare named offices, payment options, specialties, and treatment-plan clarity.
Use local directory sites as starting points, then verify with the office directly.
Ratings interpretation: use stars as a starting signal only; verify detailed review patterns for communication, billing, pressure, and follow-up.
Use a Miami local office comparison checklist: treatment fit, written estimate, insurance/payment clarity, urgent access, and pressure-free explanations.
typical_cost_ranges: Quotes in Miami commonly move based on imaging, sedation, lab work, specialist involvement, and whether treatment is staged.
A low teaser quote is not the same as a full-scope quote.
payment_options: Ask about in-office financing, third-party financing, staged payment options, and whether insurance changes the timing of payment.
Ask what happens to the price if treatment scope changes after imaging or specialist review.
Ask whether the office accepts CareCredit, in-house payment plans, insurance assignment, Medicaid/CHIP where relevant, or cash-pay estimates.
Payment Plans & Financing: compare CareCredit-style financing, in-house plans, dental school clinics, Medicaid/CHIP where applicable, and written self-pay estimates before treatment.
Before booking in Miami, ask the office to document insurance status, procedure codes, annual maximums, financing terms, and what could change after imaging.
wait_time_notes: Same-week availability should be separated from same-week treatment completion.
For urgent pain, ask whether the first visit is diagnosis only, stabilization, or definitive treatment.
availability_notes: Availability should be judged by consult speed, treatment speed, and referral access together.
If sedation or oral surgery might be needed, ask whether that changes the timeline materially.
New-patient verification for Miami: call or use the office site to confirm whether new patients are accepted for the exact treatment type, insurance path, and timeframe you need.
named_resources_or_providers: Miami-area hospital oral-surgery programs, local dental society resources, and insurer directories are often more useful than generic top dentist lists.
Use local specialist and insurer network information to verify fit before committing.
Local dental society resources, insurance provider directories, dental school clinics, and practice websites should be cross-checked before booking.
city_intro_override: Miami dental shoppers should compare treatment type, payment/insurance path, specialty fit, new-patient access, and trust signals before choosing a dentist.

primary_city_decision_block.title: Local dentist selection and payment checklist
items: Compare dentists by care type: urgent, pediatric/family, sedation, cosmetic/restorative, implant, orthodontic, or routine preventive care.
Ask for insurance status, payment-plan details, and written treatment-plan pricing before major work.
Separate same-day evaluation from same-day definitive treatment, especially for pain, infection, or broken teeth.
Ask which clinician or specialist performs the work and whether referrals are likely.
Compare review patterns for communication, pressure, billing clarity, and follow-up—not just star ratings.
Confirm new-patient availability, financing options, CareCredit or payment-plan terms, and what changes after imaging.

insurance_acceptance_notes: Ask whether the office is in-network for this specific procedure or only submits out-of-network claims.
For urgent care, confirm the real cash price even if insurance is billed later.
sedation_options: Confirm whether the office offers only local anesthesia or also nitrous, oral sedation, or referral-based IV sedation.
If sedation matters, ask whether it changes scheduling, staffing, or price.
Sedation dentist checklist: ask whether nitrous, oral conscious sedation, IV sedation referral, or non-sedation anxiety support is available and who monitors it.
emergency_triage_notes: Ask whether your symptoms need urgent treatment, imaging first, or referral to an oral surgeon or endodontist.
Same-day language should be broken into diagnosis, pain control, and definitive treatment.
For urgent dental needs in Miami, ask whether the visit is diagnosis, stabilization, or definitive treatment before comparing availability.
family_pediatric_fit: If the patient is a child or teen, confirm age fit and whether the office routinely handles pediatric cases or refers them out.

safety_net_access.axis: safety-net dental access (who can be seen, and how) - see data/research/dentistry/vertical_status.json
safety_net_access.method: Each entry was read from the clinic's own official page (or the state's official directory: Texas DSHS for Texas dental hygiene clinics) on the fetched_on date. No clinic, hour or price is inferred. Dollar figures are deliberately left out: where a source publishes a fee, the entry points to that source page instead of copying the figure.

free_low_cost.name: Borinquen Medical Centers dental
free_low_cost.eligibility: Accepts new patients in all offices, with most insurance including Florida Medicaid plans. Uninsured, low-income patients may qualify for the sliding fee for medical, dental and pharmacy needs. HRSA-supported health center.
free_low_cost.services: Comprehensive exams (X-rays, diagnosis, treatment planning), cleaning and fluoride, sealants, tooth-colored fillings, extractions, crowns and bridges, dentures, root canals (or referral), whitening and emergency services.
free_low_cost.how_to_get_seen: Call (305) 576-6611 or use the online scheduling app. Same-day appointments and free transportation to appointments are offered.
free_low_cost.cost_language: Sliding Fee Discount Program for uninsured, low-income patients: you pay the discounted rate or minimum fee, and must show proof of household income to apply (Registration: 305-576-6611 ext. 1110).

additional_sources.supports: sliding fee discount program and accepted insurance

free_low_cost.name: Community Health of South Florida (CHI) dental services
free_low_cost.address: South Miami Health Center, 6350 Sunset Drive, South Miami, FL 33143; Doris Ison Health Center, 10300 SW 216th Street, Miami, FL 33190; also West Perrine, Naranja and Homestead
free_low_cost.eligibility: Accepts most insurance plans and offers a sliding fee scale based on income for patients without insurance. A mobile dental unit also serves children at schools and childcare sites.
free_low_cost.services: Exams, cleanings, oral cancer and oral HIV screenings and emergency dental care.
free_low_cost.how_to_get_seen: Call (305) 252-4820 or the health center directly; online booking is available.
free_low_cost.cost_language: Sliding fee scale based on income for those without insurance.

free_low_cost.name: Florida Department of Health in Miami-Dade, Dr. Rafael A. Peñalver Clinic dental
free_low_cost.eligibility: Children and adults of Miami-Dade County; the clinic is staffed and managed by the county health department.
free_low_cost.services: Preventive and restorative dental care: oral hygiene, dental examinations, cleanings and fluoride treatment.
free_low_cost.how_to_get_seen: Call 305-585-2846 to schedule (Monday to Thursday 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Friday 8 a.m. to 1:45 p.m.).
free_low_cost.cost_language: County health department clinic; ask about Medicaid and discounted rates when you call.

dental_school.name: Nova Southeastern University College of Dental Medicine student clinics
dental_school.address: Davie Student Clinic, 3200 South University Drive, Davie, FL 33328 (other NSU dental clinics in Fort Lauderdale and Wilton Manors)
dental_school.eligibility: Open to new patients; student-clinic patients bring a completed prescreening form. Medicaid is accepted at some off-site clinics.
dental_school.services: A full range of dental services from dentists-in-training and residents supervised by experienced dentists, plus an urgent care clinic and faculty practice.
dental_school.how_to_get_seen: Call to make your appointment, print and complete the new patient forms, and bring any records or X-rays to the first visit.
dental_school.cost_language: Care at reduced prices, discounted compared with nearby practices; payment is due at the visit and payment plans exist for some orthodontic and prosthodontic treatment.

dental_school.name: Miami Dade College Medical Campus Dental Hygiene Clinic
dental_school.eligibility: Low-cost services for the community and for MDC students, faculty and staff; serves more than 2,000 patients a year.
dental_school.services: Cleanings, scaling, radiographs, desensitization and fluoride treatments and tobacco cessation education.
dental_school.how_to_get_seen: Call 305-237-4142 for an appointment; appointment slots run on set days each term (for example Tuesdays and Thursdays at 9:15 a.m. and 1 p.m. in fall).
dental_school.cost_language: The college describes these as low-cost services.

dental_school.name: Broward College Dental Clinic
dental_school.address: A. Hugh Adams Central Campus, Building 8, Room 159, Davie, FL
dental_school.eligibility: Open to the public by appointment; patients should have a private dentist of record, as the clinic is not meant to be a dental home.
dental_school.services: Full-service preventive dental hygiene care by students with clinic doctors: X-rays, exams, cleanings, non-surgical periodontal therapy, sealants and localized antibiotic delivery.
dental_school.how_to_get_seen: Call 954-201-6779; hours vary. Appointments last about two to three hours and sometimes several are needed.
dental_school.cost_language: Fees vary and are less than those of private dental practices.
